readings.means: the command this host itself declares for proving a change
readings.gap: THIS HOST DECLARES NO TEST COMMAND. Not "none found" and not an empty profile: the reading was taken, the tree was asked, and nothing in it declares a command that proves a change. No default is supplied here and none ever will be -- a framework that filled this blank would be publishing a way of proving a change into a host that has not chosen one, and every later reader would take the invention for a measurement. The cure is the host's: declare a test command where this kit's detectors can read it, and the next reading carries it.
